job_description:
RFTEQ Pty Ltd is always keen to speak to skilled EW specialists interested in a role at RFTEQ

We develop cutting-edge advanced technologies to protect the warfighter.

What will YOU bring to our team?

RFTEQ Company Culture

Our team spirit is strong and encourages people to stay long-term. We have monthly team dinners and social events throughout the year. We are compassionate and we look after one another. Everyone’s opinion counts and we do not support ego’s.

Employee Growth and Training

We like to improve our team skill level with training and development. We encourage career growth and support individuals with further industry-based training.

Work-life Balance

We have an excellent flexi-time policy, and the opportunity for a 9-day fortnight. We know that life gets busy and understand and support family commitments.

Location

Currently we work across two locations, and if the position is suitable, there may be the opportunity to work from home.

We want to work with exceptional people.

We are always on the lookout for new talent.

If you are an Engineer or Technologist who enjoys problem solving and technology innovation please get in contact with us via the web form below or give us a call.

Eligibility

You must be an Australian citizen with the ability to obtain a security clearance or maintain a security clearance.

KNOWLEDGE: Embedded C/C++, Communication systems, Linux embedded systems

EXPERIENCE: 2+ years

CAPACITY: Full Time

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

Embedded Software Developer who enjoys problem solving and technology innovation. This role involves development of cutting-edge communication hardware, firmware and software for real time signal processing. The work requires communication technology experience, with good mathematics skills and aptitude for creative thinking to design functional, efficient and novel hardware solutions to complex problems.

KNOWLEDGE: Systems Engineering, Engineering standards, Defence project lifecycle, GUI development

EXPERIENCE: 2+ years

CAPACITY: Full Time

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

The position is suitable for an experienced Software Developer with 2+ years of experience. The work is predominantly technical and requires excellent understanding of application design, implementing hardware interfaces such as ethernet and implementing digital signal processing algorithms. Experience with linux systems, embedded software design and communication systems are also very

desirable.

KNOWLEDGE: FPGA design, FPGA testing, VHDL, Verilog, Vivado, Matlab

EXPERIENCE: 2+ years

CAPACITY: Full Time

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

This position requires a creative and inquisitive person with a methodical approach to problem solving. The work is predominantly technical and requires excellent understanding of radio frequency (RF) concepts, FPGA and ARM processor development, digital signal processing, related hardware technology, test equipment and/or communication systems. Experience with Matlab is also very desirable.

Simply fill out the form below to get your application started. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Please ensure that you have the right to work in Australia before applying.
